domain: Food association only; not interaction outcome evidence
review_method: Official NIH ODS pages independently checked through web retrieval; concise paraphrases retained

sources.finding: L-ascorbic acid is vitamin C, occurring in foods and dietary supplements; fruits and vegetables supply it.
Folic acid is the oxidized monoglutamate used in fortified foods and supplements; it is not interchangeable with total natural food folate.
Phylloquinone is vitamin K1, associated with green leafy vegetables; other vitamin K forms remain distinct.
